title: Add built‑in bodyParser middleware with content‑type detection
description: Parsing request bodies is a common need that currently forces developers to add external packages. This middleware will automatically handle JSON, URL‑encoded, and multipart/form‑data payloads, exposing a parsed `req.body` while keeping the framework zero‑dependency.
testCases: Parse a JSON POST request and verify req.body contains the expected object
Parse an application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST and verify key/value pairs are correctly decoded
Parse a multipart/form-data request with a file upload and ensure fields and file metadata are accessible
acceptance: The middleware correctly populates req.body for JSON, URL‑encoded, and multipart requests, returns a 415 error for unsupported content types, and does not interfere with existing routes or other middleware.
reason: Provides essential request‑body handling out‑of‑the‑box, reduces external dependencies, improves developer experience, and aligns with the framework’s goal of being production‑ready with minimal setup.
